name: Autodromo Nazionale Monza
description: The Temple of Speed, in a royal park near Milan. Long flat-out straights, big stops into the chicanes, then Lesmo and the Parabolica. The lowest downforce of any circuit.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (538 of 2318 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
